label: Heart Regeneration
summary: Alucard slowly regains hearts on his own: +2 hearts every second while below the maximum.

edits.why: HUD MP-regen code: 'lw v0,g_GameTimer' -> 'jal 0x800E2B08' (the cave reloads g_GameTimer into v0)
edits.origin: unattributed (same build as the mp-items gate)

edits.why: 0x800E2B00 'jr ra; nop' stub over an unreferenced debug function + 0x800E2B08: every 60 frames, if hearts < max, hearts += 2 (capped at max)

vanilla.reason: Both locations hold vanilla bytes in 1.3.1 (0x42B00 is an unreferenced debug function) and the code only reads g_GameTimer and g_Status hearts/heartsMax.

overlaps.detail: No byte overlap: mp-items' gate cave starts at 0x42BA0 right after this cave (0x42B9C is unchanged). With this off, 0x42B00-0x42B9B go back to the dead debug function; nothing calls it.

notes: Runs from the HUD regen path, i.e. only when the MP-regen code runs (not while 0x80097BF8 bit 0 is set). No PPF found; mp-items.json already lists it as an unlisted hack.
